definitions.explanation: A thin rubber or plastic bag filled with air or helium, used as a toy or decoration. Also refers to hot air balloons in some contexts, though {気球|ききゅう} is more specific for that meaning.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{風船|ふうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らませている→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧。
examples.english: A child is blowing up a balloon.

examples.japanese: {風船|ふうせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飛|と}ばされて→飛ばす：02373_tobasu⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{消|き}えた→消える：02520_kieru⟧。
examples.english: The balloon was carried away by the wind and disappeared into the sky.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{色|いろ}とりどり→色とりどり：10404_irotoridori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風船|ふうせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{飾|かざ}り{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: We decorated the birthday party venue with colorful balloons.

notes:
USAGE:
{風船|ふうせん} literally means "wind ship" from the characters ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧ (wind) and ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧ (ship). In modern usage, it almost always refers to toy or decorative balloons. For hot air balloons used for flight, ⟦{気球|ききゅう}→気球：25477_kikyuu⟧ is preferred.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風船|ふうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らませる→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧ (to inflate a balloon)
- {風船|ふうせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{割|わ}れる→割れる：00907_wareru⟧ (a balloon pops)
- {風船|ふうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飛|と}ばす→飛ばす：02373_tobasu⟧ (to release a balloon into the air)
- ヘリウム{風船|ふうせん} (helium balloon)
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧{風船|ふうせん} (water balloon)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {風船|ふうせん}: balloon (toy or decorative)
- ⟦{気球|ききゅう}→気球：25477_kikyuu⟧: hot air balloon; balloon (for flight)
- バルーン: balloon (English loanword, used for decorative/event balloons)
